articles.title: 'Second Line in the Sky' returns to Bourbon Street honoring victims of terrorist attack
articles.description: Bourbon Street will be lit up once again this year with "Second Line in the Sky" returning for a second year. "Second Line in the Sky" was first presented in 2025 as a temporary memorial to honor and remember the victims of the January 1st terrorist attack in 2025.

articles.title: Sbarro bombing terrorist Ahlam Tamimi served with US lawsuit via X
articles.description: The United States District Court for the District of Columbia ruled that Arnold and Frimet Roth, the parents of 15-year-old Malka Roth, could serve Tamimi with legal papers through social media.
